docs.summary: A shader plus the values and keywords that configure it. Reads resolve the local value, then the parent chain, then the schema default. Setters are host thread only and O(1).
Dense id, stable for the material's life.
Name debug tools show, or null.
Swapping keeps every value whose name the new shader still has, and keeps the others for later.
Values this material does not set come from the parent. Throws on a cycle.
How the surface draws, which sets the render queue, render state and surface axes this material does not set itself. Null inherits the parent's, and with none anywhere the shader's own passes decide.
Negative means the surface's, else the shader's. Without a surface, queues from 2500 up draw as transparent.
